subject: Modular platform access and signage kitting — ramp/stairs clearance (need final by Sep 7)
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@expo-services.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Erik Johnson <erik@stagedesigns.co>
Date: 2028-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for submitting floorplan_v3 — quick note from Venue Ops: the platform you described shows a 2-step stairset leading to the demo riser. We need confirmation on accessibility compliance and final clearance before we can mark the pod as approved.

Constraints to confirm:
- Min aisle clearance to adjacent booth: 1.2 m (they're asking we hold to this).
- If you keep stairs, an adjacent ADA ramp or lift must be present or a single-level platform used.
- Overhead canopy above 36in from finished floor requires separate permit; please indicate if you plan to have any overhead elements.
- Max point load at center of platform: 900 kg/m2 — provide spec.

Shipping & logistics notes:
- Inbound crates must arrive by Sept 18 to avoid late fees.
- Labeling format: CLD2028 / HALLB / POD-B12 / crate-1etc (see attached).

I've attached the venue markup (floorplan_v3.pdf) and a photo of a similar platform (platform_sketch.jpg). If you can update and return by Sept 7 we can queue it for print and approval.

—Samantha
Event Operations, Expo Services

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf, platform_sketch.jpg

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@expo-services.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-08-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Samantha — thanks for the quick review. We talked internally and want to pivot away from a two-step stairset to a single-level approach where possible, but we'd like to keep a low-profile step for loading convenience if the ramp can be adjacent.

Actions from our side:
- Attached is updated_floorplan_v4.pdf showing a 1:12 slope ADA ramp hugging the left flank of the demo riser and a 3" loading lip instead of full stairs.
- No overhead canopy planned — we will not exceed the 36in threshold.
- Platform center-load spec: confirmed at 750 kg/m2 (manufacturer spec sheet available on request).

Logan — can you confirm we can source the ramp kit (rental or buy) and the estimated cost? Marissa, flagging for budget approval if buy needed.

We need final clearance to submit artwork for three graphic side panels and two freestanding 24x36 wayfinding signs. Samantha, you mentioned pre-print cut-off Sept 7 — we will aim to deliver print-ready files by EOD Sept 6.

Thanks,
Sofia
Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: updated_floorplan_v4.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-08-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Sofia — forwarding a quick quote from StageDesigns; Erik included on this thread. My take: keeping a small loading step plus adjacent ramp is workable and minimizes tripping risk while preserving demo sightlines.

Quoted option: modular aluminum ramp kit (1:12 slope, 48" clear) rental + installation = $1,800 (see ramp_quote_001.pdf). Buy option is ~ $4,200. If we rent, StageDesigns will deliver and install during the evening load-in window.

If procurement approves rental, I'll add the ramp to the kitting_manifest_v2.xlsx and update crate labels. Also: need to confirm we want foam core graphics (cheaper, on-site) vs. printed Dibond (heavier but reusable). My recommendation: Dibond for side panels, foam core for wayfinding.

—Logan
Exhibits Ops Lead

Attachments: ramp_quote_001.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodai.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-08-30T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Thanks — rental seems reasonable. Approve up to $2,000 on code EVENTS-EXP-28 but only if Logan can confirm there isn't a cheaper local vendor within 24 hours. Also need a final kitting manifest (single spreadsheet row per crate) before I route the PO.

Logan: please add estimated weights per crate (max 32kg single-handling encouraged), final dims, and the ramp line item.

Marcus
Finance — Events

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@expo-services.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Erik Johnson <erik@stagedesigns.co>
Date: 2028-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Sofia — good to see the updated plan. Venue Ops can approve the left-side ramp adjacent to the loading lip, pending three deliverables:
1) Final weight/load confirmation (you listed 750 kg/m2 — we need a one-page spec from the platform manufacturer).
2) Updated kitting_manifest_v2.xlsx showing crate dims and weights and clearly marking the ramp as a rental line item.
3) Artwork files submitted to our print portal by Sept 7 (link below). If those are met we will stamp the floorplan approved and release the print queue.

Shipping reminder: inbound cut-off Sept 18. Late delivery fees apply after 18th and will be billed to the exhibitor (we can help but prefer on-time).

Print portal: https://print-portal.expo-services.com/job/CLD2028-4521

—Samantha
Event Operations, Expo Services

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@expo-services.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2028-09-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modular Pod Submission — accessibility clearance needed

Thanks all — we're green to proceed. Final checklist I uploaded to Jira (EVENTS-872):
- Manufacturer one-pager for platform (attached) — confirms 750 kg/m2.
- kitting_manifest_v2.xlsx (attached) with crate dims, weights, ramp rental line item (rental = $1,800).
- Artwork delivery scheduled: Sofia to deliver print-ready PDFs by 2028-09-06 17:00 PT for pre-print.
- Shipping labels created: CLD2028 / HALLB / POD-B12 / crate-1..3.

Logan: please place the ramp rental PO under EVENTS-EXP-28 once you secure the vendor quote. Marcus: thanks for provisional budget; please process the $1,800 rental PO once Logan confirms no cheaper vendor.

Samantha: appreciate the approval — please stamp the floorplan when you receive the manufacturer spec and kitting manifest. Can we book a 15-minute call Thursday (Sept 6) 08:30 PT for a final walk-through? I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Sofia
Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: manufacturer_platform_onepager.pdf, kitting_manifest_v2.xlsx
